v2-1768466685305-0loyvyf0g.description: A sun-drenched land where ancient architectural styles blend with vibrant natural beauty, bathed in the perpetual glow of twilight.

v2-1768466685306-3gcjw1zbs.description: A picturesque stretch of coastline known for its unique architectural wonders and vibrant, cascading flora, under a sky of perpetual twilight.

v2-1768466685306-li0rpn72x.name: The Twilit Tower Residence
v2-1768466685306-li0rpn72x.description: A distinctive, multi-storied building with whitewashed, textured walls, featuring numerous arched windows, some with intricate grilles. A prominent tower is topped with a green and white patterned dome. Vibrant purple bougainvillea cascades down one side, and the entrance is marked by a wide archway decorated with blue and white tiles. Palm trees surround the building.

v2-1768472182160-o60gzpdtj.name: The Twilit Tower Residence
v2-1768472182160-o60gzpdtj.description: A distinctive, multi-storied residence characterized by its whitewashed, textured walls, numerous arched windows, and a prominent tower capped by a green and white patterned dome. Vibrant bougainvillea and surrounding palm trees add to its exotic allure, with a tiled archway marking the entrance.
forbiddenTransformations: The residence transforming into a modern glass skyscraper.

v2-1768472182160-l86l1dhpa.name: Tower Apex Chamber
v2-1768472182160-l86l1dhpa.description: You are in the highest chamber of the tower, offering panoramic views through the arched windows. The domed ceiling is visible above, painted with celestial patterns, and the interior walls echo the residence's whitewashed texture, accented by intricate tilework. This refined space feels serene and elevated.

promptLayers.background: Whitewashed plaster walls curving upwards to meet the intricately patterned, star-painted dome ceiling. Arched windows reveal glimpses of the twilight sky and distant mountains.
promptLayers.midground: Elegant, low-profile seating arranged around the perimeter, with small polished wood tables. Delicate metalwork accents are visible on the window grilles.
promptLayers.foreground: A smooth, polished wood floor reflecting the soft interior light. The subtle patterns of inlaid tiles might be visible near the walls.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft, warm light emanates from concealed fixtures, supplementing the ambient twilight glow filtering through the windows. The painted dome has a subtle internal luminescence.
promptLayers.atmosphere: An intimate, serene, and contemplative atmosphere, imbued with the tranquility of twilight and a sense of elevated seclusion.

forbiddenTransformations: The domed ceiling becoming flat or featureless.
The interior walls losing their whitewashed texture or tile accents.
The arched windows becoming square or rectangular.
The space feeling cavernous or empty.
The introduction of bright, modern artificial lights.
The view outside being obscured by modern buildings.

v2-1768472508470-urzwr04fc.description: View: Detailed texture, color variations, and delicate veins of the bougainvillea leaves, with a soft, blurred background.

v2-1768472804237-g8it2uiba.description: View: The intricate celestial patterns painted on the domed ceiling, the subtle luminescence of its surface, and any light fixtures integrated into its design.

v2-1768472936807-9kcsjbvpq.name: Otherworldly Garden of Lumina
v2-1768472936807-9kcsjbvpq.description: A lush, otherworldly garden where vibrant flora intertwines with strangely glowing statues. A gentle waterfall cascades, its mist catching the ethereal light, creating a serene yet mystical atmosphere.

promptLayers.background: Dense, exotic foliage reaching towards the twilight sky, silhouetted mountains in the far distance.
promptLayers.midground: Ornate, subtly glowing statues interspersed with lush greenery, a tranquil waterfall flowing into a pool.
promptLayers.foreground: Rich, dark soil, scattered iridescent pebbles, and the base of luminescent plants and statues.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft, ambient twilight light filtered through the canopy, augmented by the gentle, ethereal glow from the statues and phosphorescent flora.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A profound sense of serene mystery and otherworldly enchantment, bathed in soft, magical light.

v2-1768473633765-wa02a1tia.name: Overgrown Temple Chamber
v2-1768473633765-wa02a1tia.description: The interior of an ancient temple, now largely reclaimed by exotic, bioluminescent flora. Walls are carved with intricate, alien patterns, partially obscured by vines and glowing moss. The air is cool and still, carrying the faint scent of damp earth and alien blossoms.

promptLayers.background: Dark, ancient stone walls carved with intricate, alien glyphs, disappearing into shadowed depths above. Thick, bioluminescent vines hang from the ceiling, casting a soft, ethereal glow.
promptLayers.midground: Partially obscured alcoves and archways within the stone, overtaken by vibrant, glowing flora. The remnants of what might have been ancient altars or statues are visible, heavily draped in moss and roots.
promptLayers.foreground: A floor of worn, smooth stone, scattered with fallen leaves from the luminescent plants and patches of soft, glowing moss. The bases of thick, entwined roots are visible.
promptLayers.lighting: Indirect, diffused light originating from the bioluminescent plants and moss, casting soft, otherworldly blues, purples, and greens across the chamber. The light is ambient and gentle, with no harsh shadows.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A sense of deep, ancient mystery pervades the chamber, coupled with a serene, almost sacred stillness. The overwhelming presence of nature reclaiming the ruins creates an enchanted and secluded feeling.

forbiddenTransformations: no open ceiling to sky
